results.title: KikoRiki: Through the Universes
results.overview: Krosh and the Hedgehog find an unusual device in Chamomile Valley that takes them into a game about the future, where they are ordinary children on a spaceship flying to Mars. Adventures begin when the characters realize that this is not a game at all.

results.title: The Gymnasts of Fisherman Colony
results.overview: A visceral, cinematic portrait of stateless teenage girls in Pakistan defying the boundaries of gender, identity, and circumstance as they dare to imagine a different future, one gravity-defying leap at a time.

results.title: Marguerite - Cabaret Vert 2026
results.overview: Before she goes on to fill the Olympia and the Zénith venues in the autumn of 2026, Marguerite is unveiling this deeply personal world of hers in an open-air setting. We’re taking advantage of her extensive festival tour to catch her at Cabaret Vert.

results.title: Дени и Мэни в кино!
results.overview: When Deni, a Labrador, lands a major advertising contract and moves in with his agent, Andrey, he and his cat friend, Manny, who are used to being together, find themselves separated for the first time. Immersed in the dazzling world of show business, Deni gradually realizes that no amount of success can replace family, and that sincerity is more valuable than any contract. Meanwhile, Andrey is going through a crisis in his relationship with his fiancée, and it is Deni who helps him rediscover his faith in love.

results.title: Serling
results.overview: The definitive and authorized documentary on Rod Serling, the creator of the iconic Twilight Zone.

results.title: Play or Get Played
results.overview: Ava Cooper is caught in a web of love, betrayal, and hidden secrets as a dangerous affair forces her to question everyone around her.

results.title: Le Terme des Habitantes
results.overview: Rineguedebelle, Princess of Miratopia, orders, organizes, directs, orchestrates, and spells. The villagers' ball is ordered, organized, directed, orchestrated, and spelled, by Rineguedebelle, Princess of Miratopia. Rehearsals will be necessary. Three taps of the staff.

results.title: Thank You for Coming
results.overview: The play revolves around a singer from a working-class neighborhood named Zalabia who dreams of fame. A maestro discovers her and supports her in achieving her artistic dream, leading her through numerous challenges and lessons along the way.

results.title: All the Sorrow of This World
results.overview: Tired, Jeanne returns home with shopping. From the threshold, by the sounds in the closed room, she understands that her husband has been drinking. Jeanne tries not to react to this, but the aggressive husband, without leaving his room, shows a heavy temper. Without finishing peeling the potatoes, Jeanne throws on a down jacket and runs out of the house in her slippers.

results.title: Mon Priya | মন প্রিয়া
results.overview: A tender love story unfolds as romance and family responsibilities collide, testing whether two hearts can stay united in Mon Priya.

results.title: Goblin II
results.overview: Five years later, Sara and Sam face off against a familiar foe amidst a village in chaos, risking everything to protect what they love as evil rises again.

results.title: Aloha, Malandro!
results.overview: Broke and daydreaming about Hawaii, Jairo envisions an easy life without hard work. His chance comes when his depressed half-brother, Barãozinho, gets involved with the sister of an art smuggler. Jairo sees the perfect opportunity to steal from the guy and make his dream a reality. But he didn’t plan on falling in love—or accidentally getting tangled up in a string of murders, turning his dream scheme into a full-blown nightmare.

results.title: Caught Slippin
results.overview: Three couples-Shawn and Chelsea, Mack and Ciara, and Jen and Mike-go on a weekend getaway to Joshua Tree. The trip takes a dark turn when Mack goes missing after the first day. As tensions rise and secrets come to light, the friends must confront their deepest fears and suspicions, unraveling a mystery that threatens to change their lives forever.

results.title: Fest Godzilla II: Tokyo Vanishing
results.original_title: フェス・ゴジラⅡ 東京消失
results.overview: As Godzilla unleashes energy powerful enough to engulf and obliterate Tokyo with its heat ray, a new threat, Monster X, emerges. Amidst the fierce clash between these two titans, a Self-Defense Force officer undertakes a perilous, do-or-die mission!

results.title: Fernanda
results.overview: A portrait of one of Brazil’s greatest actresses, centered on the one thing inseparable from her identity: her craft. The documentary follows Fernanda Montenegro through her most recent work while looking back at the past to trace the making of a great actress over the course of her career. Directed by Pedro Waddington, son of filmmaker Andrucha Waddington—Fernanda’s son-in-law—the film embraces their family relationship as part of its narrative, capturing intimate moments with the actress backstage and unveiling previously unseen footage of projects made together as a family.

results.title: Disco
results.overview: Fourteen year old JoJo has a sleepwalking episode that leaves her haunted and determined to solve its mystery.

results.title: Spiders on My Lashline
results.overview: Covered in blood following an attack, genderqueer Ash seeks catharsis through a church confessional. As they feverishly recall memories that led them to the present day, Ash emerges from the darkness, finding strength and power for revenge.

results.title: Paul and Greg and Amelia
results.overview: A novelist struggling with writer's block interviews his wealthy estranged college roommate and his wife, where an old secret threatens all of their safety.
